subject: api_contracts
summary: OpenAPI adequately makes W3 unauthorized reserve and unauthorized release checkable at standard density: POST /reservations elevates 403 UnauthorizedError with no-hold / stock-and-holds-unchanged semantics; new POST /reservations/{holdId}/release documents the same UnauthorizedError channel as first-class; W1 200 and W2 400 InsufficientStockError paths are retained. solidsdd-lint is pass (minors only) after fixing invalid run-state/work-plan status tokens. Authorized restore remains deferred to W4 as planned.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text (unchanged by API apply)
lint: overlapping touches on shared OpenAPI/OCL/src across W3–W5; serialize waves

Reusable UnauthorizedError response component is defined but unused; operations document the channel inline under 403. Polish only—errorType enum and examples already make the failure distinguishable.
Release success (204) is a placeholder pending W4 authorized restore; W3 checkability rests on the 403 UnauthorizedError channel—adequate isolation at standard density.

No-hold and unchanged stock/holds side effects for UnauthorizedError are stated in description/example prose rather than structured response fields; adequate at standard density with a named errorType (OCL owns mutation posts).
